h2: Regular Pool Service Kuta & Legian – Scheduled Care
intro: If your villa sits along Jl. Padma or deeper into Tuban, keeping the pool balanced between trips back home takes real effort. Our Regular Pool Service Kuta & Legian covers scheduled cleaning, water chemistry, and equipment checks — then sends you a photo report on WhatsApp after every single visit. You stay informed without being here.

sections.text: Each scheduled visit follows the same routine so nothing slips through the cracks. We vacuum the floor, brush the walls, empty the skimmer basket, test pH and chlorine levels, top up chemicals as needed, and run a quick check on the pump and filter housing. Afterward you receive a short WhatsApp message with before-and-after photos, the day's water readings, and a note on anything we adjusted or flagged. If a part looks tired — a worn O-ring, a clogged strainer — it goes in that report too.

sections.h3: Why Coastal Pools Here Need Extra Attention
sections.text: Kuta Beach and Legian sit close enough to the ocean that salt-laden air settles on ladders, handrails, and pump fittings daily. Metal components corrode faster here than inland, and the low-lying lanes around Tuban flood during heavy monsoon rain, dragging sand and debris straight into skimmer intakes. Older guesthouses along Jl. Padma also share drainage lines with neighbours, so back-pressure can push grit into your pool plumbing. Scheduled attention catches these small shifts before they become costly repairs.

To set up a schedule, send us a few photos of the pool area on WhatsApp — the water surface, the pump housing, and any visible fittings or ladders. A rough note on how many times per week you'd like visits helps too. We'll confirm availability, walk through what's included, and agree on a routine that fits your villa's size. Everything from booking to post-visit reports stays in one chat thread.

A few small habits between scheduled stops protect the whole system. Rinse the skimmer basket after heavy rain so sand doesn't pack into the filter media. If you notice a faint metallic smell or greenish tinge around ladders near Kuta Beach, flag it early — corrosion spreads quickly in humid coastal air. Keep the pump cover closed when not running; dust and insects get in fast during dry season. And if a neighbour reports a drain backup on your lane, check your pool return line for backflow before the next visit.

faq.q: How often should I book pool service here?
faq.a: It depends on pool size, guest turnover, and how close you are to the coast — we'll suggest a frequency after seeing photos of your setup on WhatsApp.

faq.q: What does the post-visit report include?
faq.a: You get photos of the cleaned pool, the day's pH and chlorine readings, and a short note listing anything adjusted or flagged for follow-up.

faq.q: Can I pause my schedule while travelling?
faq.a: Yes — just message us on WhatsApp a few days ahead and we'll shift or hold visits around your dates.
